children.name: README.md
children.content:
# ☕ Complete Java & JVM Enterprise Architecture Track

Welcome to your full Java 21+ learning workspace materialized with **Trak**.

## 📚 Comprehensive Module Index

| Module | Title | Key Topics Covered |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-maven-toolchain` | **Setup & Toolchains** | JDK 21 installation, Maven `pom.xml`, javac, java execution |
| `01-jvm-architecture-and-memory-layout` | **JVM Internals & GC** | ClassLoader, Heap (Eden, S0, S1, Tenured), Metaspace, Stack frames, G1/ZGC |
| `02-primitives-and-integer-cache` | **Primitives & Cache** | 8 Primitives, Integer Cache (-128..127), Autoboxing, `var` type inference |
| `03-strings-and-string-constant-pool` | **Strings & Pool** | `String` vs `StringBuilder`, String Constant Pool, `.intern()`, Text Blocks |
| `04-control-flow-and-pattern-matching` | **Pattern Matching** | Modern `switch` with `yield`, `instanceof` pattern matching, record patterns |
| `05-oop-and-access-modifiers` | **OOP Principles** | Encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, `public`/`protected`/`private`/package-private |
| `06-interfaces-sealed-classes-records` | **Modern Types** | Default/static interface methods, `sealed` classes with `permits`, `record` classes |
| `07-generics-and-type-erasure` | **Generics & PECS** | Type erasure, bounded wildcards `? extends T` vs `? super T` (PECS rule) |
| `08-java-collections-framework` | **Collections (JCF)** | `ArrayList`, `HashSet`, `TreeSet`, `HashMap` bucket treeification, `ConcurrentHashMap` |
| `09-lambdas-and-streams-api` | **Lambdas & Streams** | `@FunctionalInterface`, Method references `::`, Streams (filter, map, flatMap, collect) |
| `10-optional-and-null-safety` | **Optional & Null Safety** | `Optional<T>`, `map`, `flatMap`, `orElse`, `orElseThrow` |
| `11-exception-handling-architecture` | **Exception Architecture** | Checked vs Unchecked exceptions, try-with-resources `AutoCloseable` |
| `12-concurrency-and-jmm` | **Concurrency & JMM** | Java Memory Model, `volatile`, `synchronized`, `ReentrantLock`, `CompletableFuture` |
| `13-virtual-threads-project-loom` | **Virtual Threads** | Project Loom (Java 21), `Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor()` |
| `14-annotations-and-reflection` | **Annotations & Reflection** | Custom annotations `@Retention`/`@Target`, Reflection API, dynamic inspection |
| `15-spring-boot-architecture` | **Spring Boot 3.x** | `@RestController`, `@Service`, Dependency Injection, Spring Data JPA |
| `16-file-io-nio-and-http-client` | **NIO & HTTP Client** | `java.nio.file.Path`, `Files.readString`, modern `java.net.http.HttpClient` |
| `17-testing-junit-and-mockito` | **Testing & Mocking** | JUnit 5 `@Test`, `@ParameterizedTest`, Mockito mocking |
| `18-interview-questions-and-drills` | **Interview Master Drill** | Top 10 enterprise Java interview questions & JVM memory tuning flags |

---

## 🛠️ How to Compile & Run

Run any module with Java 21+:
```bash
cd 00-setup-and-maven-toolchain
java Main.java
```
